description: AutoStream provides automated video editing tools for content creators.
policies: No refunds after 7 days of purchase.
24/7 support is available only on the Pro plan.
Basic plan users get email support during business hours.
You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time.
Billing is monthly and auto-renews unless cancelled.

faqs.question: What platforms does AutoStream support?
faqs.answer: AutoStream supports YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and Twitter/X.

faqs.question: Can I try AutoStream for free?
faqs.answer: We offer a 7-day free trial on both Basic and Pro plans. No credit card required.

faqs.question: What video formats are supported?
faqs.answer: AutoStream supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and MKV input formats.
